rv.q: A scenario which begins by stretching credibility, quickly degenerates into implausibility.
Firewing doesn't quite live up to its themes, and by the end has fallen into cliché, but Pearson – a graduate of the INSPIRE programme – has an intriguing voice which marks him as one to watch.

cn.t: Mixed reviews greet this debut play about a wildlife photographer and his young protégé, with critics finding the premise implausible and the execution uneven despite its exploration of connection and perception.
